entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. I want to return this piece of junk tracker, and I want to do it now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and I can help you with that. Can I please get your name and order number to start?
It's Mark Peterson, order number 775-B2190. And you better help me, because I'm not taking no for an answer.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. I can definitely look into the return options. First, could I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a piece of junk, that's the issue! I don't like it. And don't you dare tell me it's **too late** to return it. I've read about companies like yours hiding behind some ridiculous new **policy** about **hygiene** or **sanitation** to deny returns. I want a manager right now if you're going to try that.
I understand your concern, Mark. There's no need for a manager. Let me just quickly verify the return eligibility based on your delivery date. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've checked the details, and you are well within the return period. I can process this for a full refund for you right now.
Wait, what? You're approving it? Just like that? I've had it for over a month.
That's correct. The VeloBand GPS Tracker has a 10-day return window from the day you receive it. You're only on day 32, so we have plenty of time. I have already initiated the return in our system.
Oh. Seriously? I was all ready for a fight. I'm going to get all my money back?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, pack the device in its original box, and drop it off.
Wow. Okay. Well... thank you, Diana. I appreciate you making that easy. Sorry I was a bit aggressive at the start.
It's completely understandable. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No, that's all. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
